_about: THE CRM'S OWN HELP (dev kit part 3): the tour steps and the questions in the Help center. When the same question arrives in the feedback inbox twice (kind 'A question'), add it here with its answer. ids are lower-case words and hyphens and NEVER change once used: the open counts are kept per id (table help_faq_opens). Answers are plain text, and every answer must say what the CRM really does.

tour.title: The left card
tour.body: Everything in Intake is one click away here. The numbers show what is waiting.

tour.title: Inbox
tour.body: Every new message from every channel lands here first, in the column of the day it arrived. Make a lead: say the programme and the next step on the card - Follow up on a date, or Cold - and add the email or phone the message did not bring, so their next message finds them. What they wrote stays on their History. A message from somebody already in Intake goes on their history with Answer the question for today, on every channel, also when they are admitted or not proceeding. A card that says Joins and a name: Add to them. Anything else: Set aside, and pick why: Not a prospective student, Supplier or vendor, Internal or Spam. It is kept, and can be brought back; who, when and why stay on record. Supplier or vendor, Internal and Spam also mark the number or address, so it stays out of the Inbox until Remove mark. Somebody set aside before who gets in touch again comes back, with Set aside before on the card. Calls show the line you answer (Admissions, Student coordination or Other); the Line filter shows another line or all of them, and remembers your choice. Calls today from people already in Intake have no card, so they are listed at the top of the Inbox with a link to each person. A call card, and any card without a name, asks for the name first. An empty column folds to a thin strip; click it to open it. On a phone the days stack: tap a bar or a folded day to open it. Email: the same new sender again joins their card; a newsletter is set aside. An email card shows only what the person newly wrote, without the earlier emails quoted under it, signatures or legal notices; Show more opens the rest of it, Show original the email as it came. Email a person gave the Admissions label in edu@ is never filtered, archived or not, and a message a rule had set aside comes back once it has the label. Email is read every 5 minutes.

tour.title: Due
tour.body: Who needs an action now: overdue, due today, and people with no next step. Press Done, say how it went and choose the next step: Follow up on a date, or Cold; on a card with no next step, press Choose. Drag a card to Due today or Coming up to move its step to another day. An empty column folds to a thin strip; click it to open it. On a phone the columns stack: tap a card above or a folded column to open it.

tour.title: Journey
tour.body: Everyone you are working with, stage by stage, up to Admitted or Not proceeding. The last line of every card is its state - Overdue, Due today, Due, No next step or With the SIS; the card's left edge is red when it needs you (Overdue, No next step) and navy when it is on track; the bands inside a column group them and count them. The graph above the board stacks the same two colours per stage; click a colour to open those people. Search, add a lead, filter by where they came from. An empty column folds to a thin strip; click it to open it. On a phone the stages stack one under the other, one open at a time: tap a bar or a folded stage to open it, and Move on the opened card changes the stage.

tour.title: Light, System or Dark
tour.body: Choose how Intake looks. System follows your computer.

tour.title: Stuck, or have an idea?
tour.body: The Feedback button is on every screen. The Help center has this tour and the answers to questions about Intake.

faq.q: Can I delete a person?
faq.a: No. Nobody is deleted. When someone is not going ahead, close them as Not proceeding with a reason. They stay on record on the Journey, under Not proceeding. The original messages and call records behind them are kept for 13 months.

faq.q: What does "late" mean in the Inbox?
faq.a: Nobody has handled the message by the end of the working day it should have been answered in. Working hours are Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 Riga time. One working hour after it arrived the card first says "answer now"; a message that arrives in the evening or at the weekend counts from the next working morning.

faq.q: What do the colours on the cards mean?
faq.a: Two colours. Red means the person needs you: Overdue, with the days late, and No next step - press Choose on the card to set one. Navy means on track: Due today, Due with the date, and With the SIS, the student information system holds the person once their application form is submitted. Somebody the SIS says only made an account or started the form gets the step Call: did they finish the application form? The last line of the card says which. In the Inbox red is Late or Answer now, navy is New, with how long the message has waited. Inside a column the bands group the cards by state and count everyone in that state, the people behind N more too. The Journey's graph stacks the same two colours per stage, red at the bottom; a click on a colour opens those people, and the State filter offers the five states.

faq.q: How do I move someone along?
faq.a: On Journey, drag the person to the next stage when something real has happened. Click a person to see their details and their next step.

faq.q: How do I see who is active in one programme?
faq.a: On Journey, open List, pick the Programme and set Stage to Active: everyone not yet Admitted or Not proceeding, with how many beside Active.

faq.q: Where do I see a person's latest note on Journey?
faq.a: On Journey, open List: under each person one quiet line shows their newest note (a note or call written on their page, their Notes field, or the line typed under an answered call) with who wrote it and the day, and their History keeps every note.

faq.q: Who owns a lead I make from the Inbox?
faq.a: Admissions, also when no programme is picked yet on the card (only a lead Marketing makes without a programme stays with Marketing).

faq.q: How do I read a whole comment and correct one I wrote?
faq.a: On the Journey List a click on the note line opens the whole comment, and the opened row lists every comment with who and when, where Edit corrects one you wrote (an admin any, the Notes field everybody) and History keeps the old text, while new comments go in the one Add a comment box.

faq.q: Why are the sources on the Inbox cards in colour?
faq.a: So you can see where a message came from at a glance: each source has its own colour, for example Email, Phone, Website, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram. Any other source is grey. The red or navy edge of the card still says whether it needs you.

faq.q: How do I choose a next step?
faq.a: Two answers. Follow up: pick the date, it is required. Cold: they are kept as Not proceeding, tagged Cold, so they can come back later; a reason only if you know one. Steps planned earlier keep their names. In the Inbox you can add a note too.

faq.q: What is "Email reply sent" in a person's History?
faq.a: Intake reads when edu@ first replied to an email enquiry: only the time of the first reply sent from edu@ in that conversation, never its text. For a call, the reply is the first answered call.

faq.q: Where do the Home numbers come from?
faq.a: From the people in Intake, counted for the years ticked in the Year filter, top right: one or several whole years, and this year when you open Intake. Admitted counts by the admission date, everything else by the day someone arrived. Click a Home number to see it one level deeper, and the people it counts. A single month is chosen on Reports, in the month choice beside the download. Download on the Journey or on Reports gives the figures as Excel, Google Sheets or CSV.

faq.q: What are the two bars on the Admitted card?
faq.a: The year's admission target. The first bar counts everyone admitted in the year against the target; the second counts the officer programmes against their share of it. Each line says the figure, the target and how far along it is. The orange tick at the end of a bar is the target. Hover a bar to see the target and where it comes from. The bars show when one year is ticked in the Year filter, on Home and on the Admitted tab of Reports.

faq.q: Can I send someone a link to a person?
faq.a: Yes. Copy the address from the browser and send it. Anyone with an Intake account opens it; if they are signed out, they sign in first and then land on it.

faq.q: How do calls reach the Inbox, and how do I set one aside?
faq.a: Intake reads the college phone line every minute, and a call appears as soon as the phone system lists it, which can be later than the call itself. Intake also re-reads the last two days, so a call the phone system lists late is never missed. A call card shows each call: the time, the line it came in on, and Answered by who answered, or Missed. When the phone system gives the length, an answered call also shows how long the talk lasted, and a missed call how long it rang. A call from somebody already in Intake goes on their history instead. Under an answered call, type one line in What was it about?; it goes onto the person's History with Make a lead. Set aside on a call card, then pick why (Bring back returns it). Not a prospective student sets aside only that card: the next call from the number comes in as usual. Supplier or vendor, Internal or Spam also marks the number: it never reaches the Inbox, until Remove mark. A call pops up in the app for button 1 (Admissions) and button 2 (Coordinator); a button 3 call does not pop up, it only reaches the Inbox or the history. A marked number never pops up. A call pops up only for the people of its line (1 Ieva, 2 Laura), never for admins.

faq.q: Which emails reach the Inbox?
faq.a: An email to edu@ reaches the Inbox only when it has the Admissions label or what the sender newly wrote is about studying (a programme, a course, an application, admission, the dormitory, tuition or documents for studies); an email from somebody already in Intake goes on their History, a reply joins its conversation (our own reply from edu@ or any @novikontas.org too, counted as the first reply, never as a card), a newsletter or mass mail (list headers, a line like pass this message or a greeting to colleagues) is set aside as Newsletter or mass mail and mail from an agency such as PMLP as Agency / authority, whatever they mention, and everything else is set aside as Filtered automatically with the reason, our own emails as Our own email, where you can find it and Bring it back.

faq.q: Where do LinkedIn leads come from?
faq.a: From LinkedIn lead forms on the Novikontas Academy page (and ad forms, when an ad account is set), once an admin has pressed Subscribe leads on the LinkedIn channel (Channels, LinkedIn). Each lead lands in the Inbox as LinkedIn, and its answers fill in a few seconds later, dropdowns included. A lead withdrawn on LinkedIn is never added: if we already know the person, it is noted on their history.

faq.q: How does the academy WhatsApp reach Intake?
faq.a: The number stays on the academy phone and staff keep answering there. Once an admin has pressed Connect WhatsApp (Channels, WhatsApp) and scanned the code in WhatsApp Business, every message also lands in the Inbox as WhatsApp. A reply sent from the phone is counted as the reply time; its text stays on the phone. Old chats are not brought in.

faq.q: Why do I see two tiles after signing in?
faq.a: Your account opens both Academy and Training Centre, so you pick one, and the logo at the top of the menu brings you back to the two tiles; with one of them you land in it straight away.

faq.q: Light, dark or system?
faq.a: Use the Light, System, Dark switch at the bottom of the left card (on a phone, at the bottom of the page). System follows your computer, and changes when it does. The choice is remembered on this device.

faq.q: Can I install it as an app?
faq.a: Yes. In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon at the right end of the address bar. Intake then opens in its own window, with the Academy logo on the desktop and the taskbar.

faq.q: Something is wrong or missing
faq.a: Press Report a problem above, or the Feedback button in the corner. You can add a screenshot. It reaches the people who build Intake.

tc._about: THE TRAINING CENTRE HALF (19.10.2026): its own how-to and questions, shown in its Help center and served with /api/tc/meta (never with /api/config, which is Academy). One sentence per answer. ids never change once used.

howto.do: See who to contact this week
Log a call, an email or a meeting
howto.where: The company page, Log a communication
Clients, under Companies in the menu

howto.do: Place the contacts from Client Hub
See who the Save the Date did not reach
See the biggest clients and who to call back

faq.q: What is the Training Centre side of Intake?
faq.a: It holds every client company of the Training Centre with its people, its courses per year, every communication and the next contact, apart from Academy's applicants.

faq.q: Who can open Training Centre?
faq.a: Only accounts an admin has given Training Centre on People and access, and each of them sees every company, with the Person in charge filter to narrow the list.

faq.q: What is an active client?
faq.a: A company with at least one delegate on a course in any year; every other company counts as a prospect.

faq.q: Where does Delegates trained come from?
faq.a: It adds up the delegates on every company's course lines for all years, as imported from the Excel (figures till 24.09.2025) and as typed on the company page since.

faq.q: How do I set the next contact?
faq.a: On the company page, write what happened under Log a communication and pick the date of the next one, or set the date under Next communication.

faq.q: What does the Training Centre Home count?
faq.a: Home counts the year picked at the top, from the course lines (TOTAL group rows left out), every figure opens the companies it counts, and Today counts your own planned contacts up to today and up to Friday.

faq.q: What is the Client book?
faq.a: The Client book ranks the clients by delegates in the picked year (All, Mine or one area) and lists Welcome back: companies that trained with us two and three years ago but not this year, each with Plan a call.

faq.q: Who is the person in charge, and what is Mine?
faq.a: An admin picks the person in charge on the company page, from the Intake accounts or the names without Intake access, the planned next contact moves to the new person with the company, and Mine on Companies and Next contacts shows the companies in your own charge.

faq.q: How do I place the contacts that came from Client Hub?
faq.a: Open Companies, Review list: each row already has its suggested company chosen, so tick the rows that are right, change the company in a row where it is not, press Place, and pick Not a contact for us with a few words for a row that does not belong.

faq.q: What does the Grand Opening page show?
faq.a: The Save the Date for 27 May 2027 as Client Hub recorded it: who it was sent to, who it reached and who it did not, what came back (a person opening it, Apple Mail that cannot tell, a security scanner only, or no open), and Add to Calendar, which is interest and not an RSVP.

faq.q: What is an overdue contact?
faq.a: A company whose next communication date has passed without a communication logged, shown under Overdue on Next contacts until somebody logs one or moves the date.

faq.q: What is Information to send?
faq.a: Whatever still has to be sent to a company, written on its page; Home counts the companies where it is filled in, and emptying it takes the company off that count.

faq.q: How do I add this year's courses?
faq.a: On the company page, under Courses per year, type the year, the number of delegates and the course codes, and press Save.

faq.q: What do the statuses mean?
faq.a: Not contacted, To contact, Contacted, Met (with the meeting type) and Focus are the Excel's own steps, and a company that had none in the Excel starts as Not contacted.

faq.q: Can I delete a company?
faq.a: No, a company or a contact is archived, which takes it off every list and keeps its history.

faq.q: How do I get to Academy from here?
faq.a: Click the logo at the top of the menu to go back to the two tiles and open Academy, if your account opens it.

faq.q: How does My week work?
faq.a: My week shows your planned contacts from Monday to Friday; Log on a card saves what you did, how it went and when the next contact is, and a contact not done on its day waits in today's column.

faq.q: What is on the Season page?
faq.a: Season shows the exhibitions, the October to December round of asking last year's clients for their training plans, and the year-end calendars and gifts, from September to August.

faq.q: How do I follow up an exhibition?
faq.a: Open the exhibition from Season and move each company from On the list to Met at the stand, Follow-up sent or Booked a course; every move is written in the company's history.
